login_providers.title: Third-party Sign-in
login_providers.description: Manage reusable provider credentials, preflight and activate them, then atomically select the providers available to each App.
login_providers.columns.name: Configuration
login_providers.filters.query: Search name or provider client identifier
login_providers.security.title: Secrets are write-only server data
login_providers.security.description: AppSecret, Client Secret, and Apple private keys are never returned, placed in App configuration, or logged. Update them through the separate one-time form.
login_providers.editor.secret_title: Secrets are separated from base configuration
login_providers.editor.secret_descriptio: To add or rotate a secret, close this drawer and use Update secret in the list. Existing values are never returned.
login_providers.field.name: Configuration name
login_providers.field_help.wechat_app_id: The mobile AppID approved by WeChat Open Platform, formatted as wx followed by 16 characters.
login_providers.field_help.github_client: The public Client ID for the GitHub OAuth App.
login_providers.field_help.apple_client_: Native iOS sign-in uses the Bundle ID with Sign in with Apple enabled.
login_providers.field_help.server_client: Use the Web OAuth Client ID created in Google Cloud as the server-side ID Token audience, not the Android Client ID.
login_providers.field_help.android_packa: Must exactly match the published app and the Android applicationId registered with the provider.
login_providers.field_help.android_app_s: Enter the production app signature required by WeChat Open Platform.
login_providers.field_help.ios_bundle_id: Must match Apple Developer configuration and the native project's Bundle ID.
login_providers.field_help.ios_universal: Enter a verified HTTPS Universal Link that exactly matches WeChat Open Platform.
login_providers.field_help.harmony_bundl: Must match the HarmonyOS project and WeChat Open Platform Bundle Name.
login_providers.field_help.app_return_ur: After receiving the provider callback, the server uses this allowlisted HTTPS URL to return a one-time App ticket.
login_providers.field_help.team_id: The 10-character Team ID for the Apple Developer team.
login_providers.field_help.key_id: The 10-character private-key ID with Sign in with Apple enabled.
login_providers.field_help.android_certi: Enter one colon-separated SHA-256 certificate fingerprint per line; production and test certificates may coexist.
login_providers.field_help.app_secret: Sent only to the server for encrypted storage and never returned after saving.
login_providers.field_help.client_secret: Sent only to the server for GitHub code exchange and never returned after saving.
login_providers.field_help.private_key_p: Paste the complete one-time Apple .p8 private key; it is encrypted only on the server.

login_providers.validation.external_clie: Enter a valid provider client identifier.
login_providers.validation.wechat_app_id: Enter the 18-character WeChat AppID beginning with wx.
login_providers.validation.apple_client_: Enter a valid Apple Bundle ID.
login_providers.validation.server_client: Enter a server Web Client ID ending in .apps.googleusercontent.com.
login_providers.validation.max_length: The value exceeds the allowed length.
login_providers.validation.android_packa: Enter a valid Android package name.
login_providers.validation.ios_bundle_id: Enter a valid iOS Bundle ID.

login_providers.validation.wechat_ios_pa: iOS Bundle ID and Universal Link must both be present or both be empty.

login_providers.validation.key_id: Enter the 10-character uppercase Apple Key ID.

login_providers.feedback.preflight: Preflight completed. Review the latest result.
login_providers.feedback.error: The operation failed. Check the input, provider state, and permissions, then retry.
login_providers.feedback.conflict: Another administrator updated this configuration. Refresh before confirming again.
login_providers.feedback.conflict_descri: Refresh updates only the concurrency version and read-only metadata. Your current form values are retained and are not overwritten or replayed.
login_providers.feedback.conflict_refres: The concurrency version was refreshed and your edits were retained. Review them before saving again.
The latest configuration could not be loaded. Your edits are still retained; try again later.
login_providers.feedback.load_error: Third-party sign-in configurations could not be loaded.
login_providers.feedback.catalog_mismatc: The server provider catalog is incompatible with this Admin version
Editing and binding are stopped to avoid writing unknown fields. Upgrade Admin to a version that matches the server capability catalog.
login_providers.confirm.activate: After activating “{name}”, only Apps that selected this configuration may receive the provider. Runtime still requires an enabled binding and successful preflight.
login_providers.confirm.disable: Disabling “{name}” immediately fail-closes its {count} App bindings, so clients stop showing this sign-in option.
login_providers.confirm.delete: Delete “{name}”? Only configurations unused by any App can be deleted.
login_providers.unsaved.title: Discard unsaved changes?
login_providers.unsaved.description: Closing discards the unsaved changes in this provider configuration.
login_providers.secret.title: Update {provider} secret
login_providers.secret.write_only: The current secret is never returned
login_providers.secret.description: This submission replaces the entered secret. Closing immediately clears the plaintext input from the browser.
login_providers.binding.title: Enable third-party sign-in per App
login_providers.binding.description: Each provider can select only an active, preflight-ready configuration in the same tenant. All four providers save in one atomic request; a conflict never partially applies.
login_providers.binding.config_required: Select an available configuration before enabling this provider.
login_providers.binding.provider_unavail: This Admin build does not match the server provider capability, so this provider is locked.
login_providers.binding.runtime_fail_clo: The referenced configuration is disabled or no longer preflight-ready, so runtime will not show or accept this provider. Select a new available configuration and save.
login_providers.binding.ready: This provider meets the server delivery conditions
login_providers.binding.rebuild_required: Provider identity must also be included in the native build. Saving here does not change installed Apps automatically.
login_providers.binding.validation: Select a valid configuration for every enabled provider.
login_providers.binding.load_error: The App's third-party sign-in configuration could not be loaded.
login_providers.binding.conflict: At least one configuration changed elsewhere. Nothing was partially applied; refresh and confirm again.
login_providers.binding.conflict_descrip: Refresh merges only the latest concurrency versions for all four providers. Your selections, switches, and order are retained and not replayed.
login_providers.binding.conflict_refresh: Concurrency versions refreshed. Local edits for all four providers were retained; review them before saving.
The latest bindings could not be loaded. Your local edits were not lost; try again later.
login_providers.guide.trigger: View provider application and integration guidance
login_providers.guide.title: Third-party Sign-in Provider Guide
login_providers.guide.intro: Prepare the production app identifiers and signatures before applying in each provider console. Provider requirements may change; verify them through the official links below before submitting.
login_providers.guide.provider.wechat.su: Native WeChat authorization for Android, iOS, and HarmonyOS; the client submits only a one-time code.
login_providers.guide.provider.wechat.st: Register and verify the developer entity
Sign in to WeChat Open Platform with the organization that owns publishing rights and complete developer verification.
Submit app information and accurately register the production Android package and signature, iOS Bundle ID and Universal Link, and HarmonyOS Bundle Name.
After approval, copy the AppID. Paste AppSecret only in the separate secret window, never in client projects.
Enable WeChat OAuth in each actual build variant, export and rebuild, then run Admin preflight.
login_providers.guide.provider.wechat.fi: The mobile AppID issued after provider approval.
Used only by the server for one-time code exchange and never sent to Apps.
Must exactly match the production Android applicationId.
Must match the production signature registered with WeChat Open Platform.
Must match the iOS project and provider registration.
A verified HTTPS Universal Link with the association file deployed and registered in the provider console.
Must match the HarmonyOS project and provider registration.
login_providers.guide.provider.wechat.no: AppID belongs in native builds. AppSecret, access tokens, and refresh tokens must remain server-only.
login_providers.guide.provider.github.su: System-browser OAuth for Android, iOS, and HarmonyOS; the server receives callbacks and issues a one-time App ticket.
login_providers.guide.provider.github.st: Use a long-lived GitHub organization or personal account and open Developer settings.
Enter the product name, homepage, and the exact read-only Authorization callback URL shown by Admin.
Save Client ID and Client Secret
Enter Client ID in the base configuration and submit Client Secret only through the separate secret window.
Provide an allowlisted HTTPS App return URL, verify Universal/App Links, then run preflight.
login_providers.guide.provider.github.fi: The public Client ID for the GitHub OAuth App.
Used only by the server for authorization-code exchange and never placed in Apps.
The HTTPS URL the server uses to return a one-time ticket after exchange.
Computed from server deployment configuration. Register it verbatim in GitHub; it is not editable here.
login_providers.guide.provider.github.no: Authorization must use state and PKCE S256 with minimal scopes. Never place the Secret in mobile code.
login_providers.guide.provider.apple.sum: Native Sign in with Apple for iOS only. The server verifies ID Tokens and retains authorization-code revocation support.
login_providers.guide.provider.apple.ste: Enable Apple sign-in for the App ID
In Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles, enable Sign in with Apple for the production Bundle ID.
Create a Sign in with Apple key
Create a Key with Apple sign-in enabled, record Team ID and Key ID, and immediately store the one-time .p8 download securely.
Enter Bundle ID, Team ID, and Key ID in base configuration; submit the private key only through the separate secret window.
Enable the Sign in with Apple capability in the iOS project, rebuild with the proper signature, then run preflight.
login_providers.guide.provider.apple.fie: Native iOS uses the Bundle ID with Apple sign-in enabled.
The 10-character Team ID in Apple Developer Membership.
The 10-character Key ID shown after creating the Apple sign-in key.
The complete one-time .p8 download; only the server uses it to generate client secrets.
login_providers.guide.provider.apple.not: Apple usually returns a user's name only on first authorization. Never persist or forward the Apple private key from the client.
login_providers.guide.provider.apple.lin: Get started with Sign in with Apple
login_providers.guide.provider.google.su: Android Google build only; Credential Manager obtains an ID Token and the server verifies its audience.
login_providers.guide.provider.google.st: Configure the Google Cloud project and consent screen
Select a long-lived Google Cloud project, configure the OAuth consent screen, and set the required publishing state.
Create Android and Web OAuth clients
Register package and SHA-256 on the Android client. Create a separate Web client for the server-side ID Token audience.
Copy the Web OAuth Client ID here. Do not use the Android Client ID; no Client Secret is required.
Add the Google ID provider only to the Android Google build, rebuild, then run preflight.
login_providers.guide.provider.google.fi: The Web OAuth Client ID used by the server to verify the ID Token aud claim.
Must match Google Console and the Android Google build applicationId.
Register the full SHA-256 fingerprint for every certificate that signs an actual build.
login_providers.guide.provider.google.no: Google sign-in does not belong in the Android China build. Do not use an FCM service account or Android Client ID as a sign-in credential.
